en: When AI Becomes a Cognitive Partner: The Limits of Linear Chat and the Search for Non-Linear Interfaces
zh: 当 AI 成为认知伙伴：线性对话的困境与非线性界面的探索

excerpts.zh: 思维可以同时分叉，线性聊天却要求问题依次排队。
excerpts.en: Thought can branch in several directions; linear chat makes questions queue up.

excerpts.zh: 注意力结构、上下文污染和导航负担，是三个不同的问题。
excerpts.en: Attention structure, context pollution and navigation burden are distinct problems.

excerpts.zh: 创建新聊天保留了分支，却不一定提供持续可见的结构。
excerpts.en: Starting a new chat preserves a branch without necessarily making its structure visible.

excerpts.zh: LatentLearn 先选择了一个具体场景：有明确主题的聚焦学习。
excerpts.en: LatentLearn starts with a specific case: focused learning around a clear topic.

excerpts.zh: 每个分支只继承必要的祖先上下文，而不是整段聊天历史。
excerpts.en: Each branch inherits relevant ancestor context rather than the entire chat history.

excerpts.zh: 节点的标题与摘要用来定位，完整内容留到需要时展开。
excerpts.en: Titles and summaries support navigation; full content opens when needed.

excerpts.zh: 当分支不断增加，树本身也可能成为新的导航负担。
excerpts.en: As branches multiply, the tree itself can become a navigation burden.

excerpts.zh: 完全自动判断偏题可能打断探索，完全手动管理又增加整理成本。
excerpts.en: Automatic topic decisions can interrupt exploration; manual control adds organizational work.

excerpts.zh: 树擅长发散，却不会自然告诉你最终理解了什么。
excerpts.en: Trees support exploration but do not automatically reveal what you learned.

excerpts.zh: 一个问题可能来自两个父节点，纯粹的树表达不了所有联系。
excerpts.en: A question can arise from two parent nodes; a tree cannot represent every connection.

excerpts.zh: 探索、阅读、记忆和表达，可能需要不同的信息结构。
excerpts.en: Exploration, reading, memory and expression may need different structures.

excerpts.zh: 真正值得设计的，是不同认知状态之间如何流畅转换。
excerpts.en: The design challenge is moving smoothly between different cognitive states.
